segments.t: Seconds later in the dining room, Nastya's father unexpectedly walks into Claude Monet for a business meeting with his sausage-factory partners, and Nastya hands the table over to Max.
Ты почему не предупредил, что придёшь?
У нас с партнёрами переговоры тут.
Кто это у нас такой щедрый?
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'Hi, Dad!' Nastya anchors the line on 'hello', while 'dad' completes the thought.
'Let me hug you. I am at work.' The grammar packs 'come on' and 'work' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
Ты почему не предупредил, что придёшь?
'Why didn't you warn me that you were coming?' The meaning hinges on 'you' working together with 'will come' in spoken Russian.
У нас с партнёрами переговоры тут.
'My partners and I have negotiations here.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'at' and finishing on 'here'.
'Will you feed us? Me — no.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'will feed' and finishing on 'no'.
'Maxim can serve you.' The grammar packs 'you' and 'to serve' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Hello! Let's go to the table.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'hello' before landing on 'table'. Vika answers right away.
'I am listening.' Vika brings out the contrast between 'I' and 'to listen' in a few short words.
'This is for you.' The meaning hinges on 'this' working together with 'you' in spoken Russian.
'Thank you.' The grammar packs 'thank you' and 'thank you' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Max answers right away.
Кто это у нас такой щедрый?
'Who is being so generous here?' Max anchors the line on 'who', while 'generous' completes the thought.

'Did you want a fine again? Go work.' In Russian, the idea of 'again' flows naturally into 'work' without extra filler words. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Ты почему не предупредил, что придёшь?
У нас с партнёрами переговоры тут.
Кто это у нас такой щедрый?
And that wraps up our ninth scene. Listen for Nastya passing her father's table to Max and Max's jealousy when flowers arrive for Vika. Until next time!
